architecture: Unchanged V5 GraphTransition, 6967 parameters, same schema/encoders/core/heads verified in R5.1 engineering. No extra features or weight reuse from an engineering probe.
direction: Primary mathematics+physics -> coding; secondary other-domain pairs -> mathematics and physics
initialization: Fresh model from seed; identical initial state hashes for B/C/R within seed. No engineering gradients or prior model weights carried forward.
training_data: All 18 qualified development tasks per domain only. Same 18 target identities and labels for every condition for each target. Auxiliary domains supply their own 18 development tasks. Qualification/composition labels are excluded from optimization.
schedule: For each target, updates1..60: B repeats target data, C/R alternate the other two domains (30 each); updates61..120 all use target. Same architecture, initialization,120x16 presentations per fit. B target encoder/head gets120 updates; C/R gets60. Record actual differences; auxiliary information is intentionally available only to C/R.
randomized_control: Before fit, permute paired source delta+validity targets separately within each auxiliary domain using a frozen PCG64 permutation keyed by optimizer seed+sum(ord(domain)). Preserve graph inputs; move masks with their permuted effect targets. Save exact permutations, original/permuted target hashes and remaining true-association counts. No permutation seed search; record rather than retune degenerate permutations.
loss: For each graph: squared error per entity = mean over output coordinates. Changed target mask = any abs(true normalized delta)>1e-8. Compute .5*mean entity error for changed entities (0 contribution if none) plus .5*mean entity error for unchanged active entities (0 contribution if none), then mean over batch plus .1*BCEWithLogits(validity). Exclude padded nodes. Changed mask is training-only supervision derived from labels; inference sees no mask/validity/outcome labels and all output effects remain uncorrected.

evaluation.primary: Macro changed-entity MSE on all9 originally frozen coding composition tasks. All27 originally frozen compositions evaluated (9/domain);3 optimizer seeds repeat those27 independent identities, not81 tasks.
evaluation.retained: Macro and scalar-pooled whole-graph MSE, changed-entity and unchanged-entity MSE, invalid-noop MSE, precondition balanced accuracy/Brier, integer consistency, rounded full-transition accuracy, per-task raw outputs/probabilities and compute.
evaluation.timing: Persist final composition predictions for all27 fits, hash-bind them and every final checkpoint BEFORE first composition outcome execution. Then execute and independently replay all27 composition tasks. Never execute extra evaluation tasks, optimize on outcomes or select a best checkpoint.
evaluation.other_domains: Measure secondary sharing regression for math and physics vs their domain-only controls, with same composition identities. Primary remains coding; do not retroactively promote a positive secondary result.
evaluation.qualification_labels: Never used for optimization, checkpoint selection or gate changes. Development curves only at updates 0,60,90,120; all final comparisons use update120.
evaluation.baselines: Persistence and local-action metrics from frozen R5.1 rules; precondition simple baseline uses only public action bounds, not executed validity. Procedural reference executor is perfect by construction and is an explicit ceiling, not a learned competitor to be beaten. No claim above expert algorithm.

formulas: Relative gain = (control_MSE-shared_MSE)/control_MSE per seed, then mean. If a control has zero changed error, positive improvement is impossible and that gain gate fails; do not invent an epsilon-assisted success. Baseline reductions compare mean shared MSE to baseline MSE. All nine tasks remain in whole/validity denominators; changed metric excludes only genuinely unchanged tasks per frozen definition, with excluded counts reported.
checkpoints: Save immutable model+Adam states at update60 and update120 for each fit with seed/condition, complete optimizer/loss history, protocol/task/source/data hashes and measured time. Record initial state hashes, final checkpoint SHA-256, parameter/device counts, actual shared and domain gradient update counts. Only final update120 enters comparison. No resume/retry path or exact bitwise continuation claim.
verification: Before optimizer: original readiness evidence/source/runtime hashes, saved native gradient receipts, complete committed protocol/task/sourcefreeze, fresh native engineering checks and independent replay of81 existing readiness outcomes. Duringfit: unchanged architecture6967 params,MPS placement,finite gradients,expected active and inactive domains,shared-core contribution from each domain,matchedinit hashes,exactupdate/presentationcounts. After: checkpoint+Adam tensor-only inspection,independent27 composition target replays,predictions before targets,independentmetrics/gate recomputation,full archive restoration. No exact continuation claim.
decision: Integrity/engineering/nonfinite/budget failure -> FAILED_PILOT and stop, without extra fits. Any predefined scientific gate fails -> NO_GO. All gates pass -> GO_TO_CONFIRMATION only. No retries,hyperparameter tuning or extra training. INCONCLUSIVE reserved for preserved incomplete/invalid evidence; cannot rescue a failed numeric gate.
authorization: Human explicitly authorized this one all-domain native pilot in the current conversation. No sandbox neural execution, second run, resume, new seed or further training authorized.
uncertainty: Report paired per-task shared-control squared-error differences and a fixed2000-resample task bootstrap within domain/condition,seed2026101701,95%percentile interval. Reuse same sampled task indices across optimizer seeds; average seed effects within sampled task. Never bootstrap individual entities or treat seeds as independent tasks. Nine tasks/domain and six expected changed tasks yield exploratory intervals only; interval is descriptive,not a gate.
